title: FIPS Cryptographic Dependency Inventory Entry
description: Schema for a single crypto-relevant Go module entry in the FIPS 140-3 dependency inventory (FIPS-DEP-001), produced by WO-009 via `go list`/go.mod classification. Distinct from fips/schemas/crypto_inventory_entry.json, which schemas per-call-site entries (file/line/function) for WO-005..WO-011/WO-008. This schema covers module-level (module_path/version) entries and is consumed by the aggregate inventory produced in WO-019.

version.description: Resolved module version as reported by `go list -m all` / go.mod (e.g. 'v0.57.0').

direct_or_transitive.description: Whether the module is a direct or transitive (indirect) requirement. When status differs across referencing_go_mods, this reflects the dominant/most-permissive classification, with the split documented in 'notes'.

referencing_go_mods.description: Which of the four in-scope go.mod files (go.mod, sdk/go.mod, internalshared/go.mod, tools/pipeline/go.mod) require this module.

crypto_operations.description: Cryptographic algorithms/operations this module provides or wraps, with evidence (source file paths) where the operation was confirmed by import-site inspection.

fips_approved_algorithms.description: Algorithms provided by this module that are FIPS 140-3 Approved (may be empty).

non_approved_algorithms.description: Algorithms provided by this module that are not FIPS 140-3 Approved (may be empty).

consolidation_finding.description: Dependency-hygiene finding string (e.g. duplicate major-version consolidation recommendation). Empty string when not applicable.

notes.description: Free-text context: reachability evidence (go mod why chains), version-status caveats across modules, and cross-references.
